third_party_evaluations.summary: Designs and operates data processing systems with security and governance on GCP.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded secure data-processing and governance scope supports professional engineering decisions at three years; vendor specificity does not establish authority over wider privacy regulation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded data-system design and operations with security and governance fit professional data engineering. The three-year profile and proctoring support knowledge assurance, while vendor scope and no stated practical limit a broader security claim.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded secure data-processing and governance scope fits professional system-design responsibility at three years. This does not by itself demonstrate expert security engineering or cross-cloud execution.
